records.title: How Contextual are Contextualized Word Representations? Comparing the Geometry of BERT, ELMo, and GPT-2 Embeddings
records.application: Foundational caution that contextual representations have model/layer-dependent geometry; the paper does not validate the present MiniLM token means or clusters.

records.title: Canary-1B-v2 & Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3: Efficient and High-Performance Models for Multilingual ASR and AST
records.application: The abstract announces Parakeet multilingual ASR across 25 languages; its 1.7M-hour and ten-times-Whisper performance claims concern Canary, not this Parakeet experiment.
